query:
update podcast
             set title = $2, author = $3, description = $4, link = $5,
                 artwork_url = $6, language = $7, metadata_hash = $8,
                 status = $9, failing_since = null, feed_error = null,
                 version = $10, show_type = $11, podcast_guid = $12, updated_at = now()
             where id = $1
